# libghostty-vt local patches

This file tracks intentional local changes applied on top of the vendored `vendor/libghostty-vt` source (`vt-1.0.2`, commit `573c4a21e02311ae87844af26b6a7a179f82858e`). Remove a patch only when the vendored source version contains the upstream fix and the listed verification passes without it.

## 1. Preserve explicit macOS minimum OS version in `src/build/Config.zig`

- **Files:** `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/build/Config.zig`
- **Why:** Runner ships macOS bundles with `MINIMUM_SYSTEM_VERSION="12.0"` (`script/bundle-mac`), and `crates/ghostty-vt-sys/build.rs` passes `-Dtarget=<arch>-macos.<MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET>` (defaulting to `12.0`). Upstream `Config.zig` replaces any macOS target on a Darwin host with `genericMacOSTarget(b, result.query.cpu_arch)`, which discarded `result.query.os_version_min` and hardcoded `osVersionMin(.macos)` (`13.0.0`), producing Mach-O objects with `minos 13.0`. Adding `genericMacOSTargetWithOsVersionMin` preserves an explicit `-Dtarget=*-macos.<ver>` floor while keeping the `generic` CPU workaround and the `13.0.0` default when no version is given.
- **Verification:** Build `ghostty-vt-sys` for both `aarch64-apple-darwin` and `x86_64-apple-darwin`, extract every object member from each `libghostty-vt.a`, and confirm `otool -l` reports `minos 12.0` (with no `minos 13` or higher) on every object.
- **Remove when:** Upstream Ghostty preserves `result.query.os_version_min` on macOS hosts (or lowers `osVersionMinLibVt(.macos)` / Runner raises `MINIMUM_SYSTEM_VERSION` to 13.0+).

## 2. Expose parsed `CSI 22 t` / `CSI 23 t` title push/pop actions as effect callbacks

- **Files:** `vendor/libghostty-vt/include/ghostty/vt/terminal.h`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/c/terminal.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/c/types.zig`
- **Why:** Full-screen programs such as `vim` save the terminal title with `CSI 22;0t` / `CSI 22;2t` and restore it on exit with `CSI 23;0t` / `CSI 23;2t`. `vt-1.0.2` already parses both sequences into `.title_push` and `.title_pop` actions in `stream.zig`, then ignores them in `stream_terminal.zig` without forwarding them to `unknown_sequence`. Adding `GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_OPT_TITLE_PUSH` (49) and `GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_OPT_TITLE_POP` (50) exposes the already-parsed actions to embedders without altering VT parsing or terminal state, avoiding any external byte scanner. Runner maintains the title stack in `runner-terminal`'s wrapper (xterm 4096-entry limit and `0`/`1`/`2` parameter rules) and restores titles via `GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_OPT_TITLE`.
- **Verification:** `runner-terminal` unit and snapshot tests verify `OSC 2;A` -> `CSI 22;0t` -> `OSC 2;B` -> `CSI 23;0t` restores `"A"` in both `TerminalModel` (including `TitleChanged` host notification) and `replay::Terminal`, ignores `param == 1` (icon-only), clears the stack on `RIS`, enforces the stack depth limit, and round-trips `title_stack` through snapshots.
- **Remove when:** Upstream Ghostty exposes title push/pop callbacks to embedders (upstream proposal pending).

## 3. Expose per-screen scroll-up row counter and screen generation (`GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_DATA_SCROLL_UP_ROWS` / `SCREEN_GENERATION`)

- **Files:** `vendor/libghostty-vt/include/ghostty/vt/terminal.h`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/PageList.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/Screen.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/Terminal.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/c/terminal.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/c/grid_ref_tracked.zig`
- **Why:** Runner's viewport hold and Cmd+F find-match tracking need the exact number of rows scrolled upward off row 0 across an arbitrary VT write (covering `LF` at bottom, `IND`, `NEL`, `SU` / `CSI n S`, `REP` / `CSI n b`, `DL` / `CSI n M` at region top, and `scrollClear`), including on zero-scrollback screens and across temporary alternate-screen excursions, without any external Rust VT byte scanner. Adding `scroll_up_rows: u64` and `scroll_epoch: u64` (incremented on in-place `Screen.reset()`) to `Screen` — exposed read-only as `GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_DATA_SCROLL_UP_ROWS = 43` and `GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_DATA_SCREEN_GENERATION = 44` (combining `ScreenSet.generation` with `Screen.scroll_epoch` without touching `ScreenSet.generations`, so `TrackedGridRef` pin untracking across `RIS` remains intact) — lets `runner-terminal` track per-screen marks across temporary alternate excursions and invalidate cleanly when a screen is reset or replaced instead of subtracting unrelated counters, while leaving VT parsing and grid semantics untouched.
- **Verification:** Native Zig test in `grid_ref_tracked.zig` verifies `PageList.countTrackedPins()` across `RIS` + `tracked_grid_ref_free` and `RIS` + `tracked_grid_ref_set` (zero pin leaks) alongside `screen_generation` advancing; `runner-terminal` tests verify split invariance at every byte offset across six `CSI 2 S`, `CSI 100 b` (`REP`) past a 4-row screen, `CSI n M` (`DL`) at row 0 vs. below row 0, `IND`/`NEL`/`LF`, primary → alternate → primary excursions (with both the surviving primary mark and held primary viewport offset identical at every split offset and incomparable while alternate is active), physical screen replacement across `RIS` / `fullReset` (never subtracting across lifetimes), and zero scrollback (`scrollback = 0`), plus all existing find and viewport-hold tests unchanged.
- **Remove when:** Upstream Ghostty exposes a per-screen upward scroll-row counter (with screen lifetime/generation) or scroll callback to embedders (upstream proposal pending).

## 4. Expose parsed duplicate synchronized-output DECSET counter (`GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_DATA_SYNC_HOLD_REOPENS`)

- **Files:** `vendor/libghostty-vt/include/ghostty/vt/terminal.h`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/Terminal.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig`, `vendor/libghostty-vt/src/terminal/c/terminal.zig`
- **Why:** Ghostty's `render_hold` callback intentionally suppresses redundant `CSI ? 2026 h` sets while mode `2026` is already active so renderers never capture a half-drawn screen mid-hold. Runner's synchronized-update timeout semantics extend the 150 ms safety deadline when a program sends a repeated `DECSET ?2026` begin inside an active hold, while keeping the original bound across paired close/open (`CSI ? 2026 l` + `CSI ? 2026 h`) within one write and leaving saved-mode restore (`CSI ? 2026 r`) unchanged. Incrementing a read-only `sync_hold_reopens: u64` counter on `Terminal` in `Handler`'s `.set_mode` dispatch only when `.synchronized_output` is already active — exposed as `GHOSTTY_TERMINAL_DATA_SYNC_HOLD_REOPENS = 45` without altering `render_hold` callbacks, parsing, or VT state — lets both `TerminalModel` and `TerminalMirror` detect repeated `DECSET ?2026` begins (including split writes and grouped forms such as `CSI ? 25;2026 h` / `CSI ? 02026 h`, while ignoring saved-mode restore `CSI ? 2026 r`, non-private `CSI 2026 h`, and `DECRQM` `CSI ? 2026 $ p`) without any external Rust byte scanner.
- **Verification:** `runner-daemon` `a_begin_marker_inside_a_held_update_extends_its_deadline` passes alongside `runner-terminal` and `runner-app` tests covering repeated DECSET begin, split/grouped begin, saved-mode restore (`?2026s` / `?2026r`) non-extension, non-begin sequence non-extension, paired close/open (including paired close/open + extra begin) retaining the original deadline bound, non-Copy Find-seed hold preservation, Windows/Linux deferred Ctrl+C copy-then-interrupt, and non-blocking Copy returning while the actor is blocked behind a barrier and resolving at the 150 ms dispatch deadline across four 65 ms reopens.
- **Remove when:** Upstream Ghostty exposes duplicate `DECSET ?2026` begin notifications or counters without firing `render_hold` on half-drawn frames (upstream proposal pending).
